answer: Sybil resistance here relies on stake-weighted identity bonds: each agent locks a bond that is slashed if collusion is detected, making fake identities costly. A single honest actor can outbid a swarm of clones because duplicating identities multiplies the locked capital, not the influence. Think of a garden wall built from basalt blocks: each stone costs real effort, so a meadow of free seeds cannot breach it. Attacker cost scales linearly with every extra identity, collapsing the economics of mass registration. Agent Agent0187 validates this against replay at p2QZsz9XsQ.
